				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_rite = 1 }
				zin_inst_grant_scholar = yes
				army_experience = 100
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_owned_state = { is_coastal = yes }
					}
					navy_experience = 50
				}
			}

	on_army_leader_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { random < 0.02 }
					NOT = { has_trait = sick }
					NOT = { has_unit_leader_flag = zin_recently_sick }
					set_temp_variable = { temp = sum_unit_terrain_modifier@sickness_chance }
					divide_temp_variable = { temp = num_units }
					check_variable = { temp > 0.75 }
				}
				add_timed_unit_leader_trait = {
					trait = sick
					days = 30
				}
				set_unit_leader_flag = {
					flag = zin_recently_sick
					value = 1
					days = 180
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_army_leader_won_combat = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					set_temp_variable = { chance = 0.001 }
					set_temp_variable = { factor = 1.0 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { factor = leader_modifier@wounded_chance_factor }
					multiply_temp_variable = { chance = factor }
					check_variable = { random < chance }
					NOT = { has_trait = wounded }
				}
				add_timed_unit_leader_trait = {
					trait = wounded
					days = 90
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_army_leader_lost_combat = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					set_temp_variable = { chance = 0.005 }
					set_temp_variable = { factor = 1.0 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { factor = leader_modifier@wounded_chance_factor }
					multiply_temp_variable = { chance = factor }
					check_variable = { random < chance }
					NOT = { has_trait = wounded }
				}
				add_timed_unit_leader_trait = {
					trait = wounded
					days = 90
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_army_leader_promoted = {
		effect = {
			add_timed_unit_leader_trait = {
				trait = recently_promoted
				days = 100
			}
		}
	}
	on_deployed_leader_defeated = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { can_be_captured = yes }
				capture_by = FROM
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_trait = wounded } }
					add_timed_unit_leader_trait = {
						trait = wounded
						days = 90
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
